_doc: Fired from code (RecreationUtility.StartFeeRequest), no trigger: a paid activity's entrance fee put to the paying faction's manager (the participant's priority home - the payer of RecreationUtility.ChargeEntranceFee) - one event per activity occurrence and payer, batched per update (RecreationUtility_FeeApproval). A request the player answers for an activity they are being invited to / notified of goes into that invitation's box instead (Recreation_Invite / Recreation_PublicInvite - Docs/Activities/Plan_ActivityPlayerPrompt.md). Self = the approver: the player for a player-managed payer, else the payer's first manager - an NPC never sees the question (npcDecides: the loaded isDefaultAccept option [支付]). $feeRequestText$ = the activity line, every participant (those waiting for this payment marked pending), the ones this payer pays for and the total; $feeConflictText$ = the player's bookings joining would clash with (built and localized by code). The request is carried only by the event's runtime callbacks (events are never saved): ExecuteCallback buildOptions = the loaded options, built just before the question shows - [支付], and for the player asked about a session they don't attend [支付并加入] (pay, then join it; disabled with the reason when they can't); ExecuteCallback decline = [拒绝]. Declining drops every participant of the request.

events._comment: Builds [支付] / [支付并加入] and the clashes text from the current state, then asks.
